[[File:Dearic_Medical_Center.jpg|thumb|300px|The Dearic Medical Center]]
The '''Dearic Medical Center''' was a small [[Medcenter/Legends|hospital]] in the city of [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. It had beds for several patients and medical equipment including a [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droid]] to treat them.

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] the [[Drall (planet)|Drall]] [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] to [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], [[Champhra Biahin]], could often be found in this facility. Aspiring [[Medic/Legends|medics]] could also find helpful physicians here who would share some of their medical knowledge with them.
